mapper.sql: id, execution_key AS executionKey, handler_name AS handlerName, status, attempt_count AS attemptCount, lease_token AS leaseToken, lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt, job_id AS jobId, log_id AS logId, log_date_time AS logDateTime, shard_index AS shardIndex, shard_total AS shardTotal, result_message AS resultMessage, last_error AS lastError, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: INSERT INTO xxl_learning_execution AS target ( execution_key, handler_name, status, attempt_count, lease_token, lease_expires_at, job_id, log_id, log_date_time, shard_index, shard_total, started_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{execution.executionKey}, #{execution.handlerName}, 'RUNNING', 1, #{execution.leaseToken}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{leaseSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second'), #{execution.jobId}, #{execution.logId}, #{execution.logDateTime}, #{execution.shardIndex}, #{execution.shardTotal}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (execution_key) DO UPDATE SET handler_name = EXCLUDED.handler_name, status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = target.attempt_count + 1, lease_token = EXCLUDED.lease_token, lease_expires_at = EXCLUDED.lease_expires_at, job_id = EXCLUDED.job_id, log_id = EXCLUDED.log_id, log_date_time = EXCLUDED.log_date_time, shard_index = EXCLUDED.shard_index, shard_total = EXCLUDED.shard_total, result_message = NULL, last_error = NULL, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target.status = 'FAILED' OR (target.status = 'RUNNING' AND target.lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_learning_execution SET status = 'SUCCESS', result_message = #{resultMessage}, last_error = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE xxl_learning_execution SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, result_message = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE xxl_learning_execution SET lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{leaseSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE xxl_learning_execution SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, result_message = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE handler_name = #{handlerName} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM xxl_learning_execution
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
